rounding: round monetary fills and commissions to nearest cent before ledger mutation; compare integer cents

offline_value.later_governed_session: the policy-specific simulator cash cents immediately after the prior governed session's exact forced-flat/exit realization and all booked fee/commission events, carried unchanged to the current 09:30 boundary
offline_value.single_source: the immutable policy causal cash ledger

live_paper_value.canonical_selection: Select the authenticated snapshot with the greatest broker source timestamp in the closed interval [09:29:00,09:30:00] America/New_York for the session date; break a source-timestamp tie only by the greatest authenticated broker update sequence.
live_paper_value.normalization: parse the broker value exactly as decimal USD, round once to nearest cent using ROUND_HALF_EVEN, and freeze the resulting integer cents for the session
live_paper_value.single_source: the selected authenticated IBKR NetLiquidation snapshot; no fallback to AvailableFunds, BuyingPower, prior-day values, estimates, or operator guesses
live_paper_value.missing_stale_ambiguous_or_late: block all new entries for the session and log SESSION_START_EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE

account_scope.configured_account: the one explicitly configured Protocol101 paper account
account_scope.dedication_requirement: the account must be declared dedicated to this Protocol101 evidence run for the entire session
zero_external_state_required: no non-Protocol101 execution or commission event since the prior session close
no unexplained deposit, withdrawal, fee, interest, dividend, or manual cash adjustment since the prior session close
account_scope.verification_source: authenticated account, position, order, execution, commission, and cash-flow snapshots joined to the immutable Protocol101 ledger
account_scope.failure: block all new entries; never subtract or estimate unrelated state

owned_trade_ledger.principle: D49 and the daily stop use Protocol101's own reconciled fill-and-commission ledger, not a lagging broker realized-PnL aggregate
owned_trade_ledger.partial_fill: reserve actual filled quantity and cash immediately; one-contract policy blocks another entry while any quantity is open or pending
owned_trade_ledger.cancel_or_reject: release only the unfilled reservation after broker acknowledgement
owned_trade_ledger.late_commission: retain a conservative preregistered commission reserve until exact commission arrives; reconcile cents without rewriting prior decision records
owned_trade_ledger.realized_session_pnl_cents: sum exact net closed-trade PnL cents for this session

d49.soft_close_trigger: At flat decision t, permanently soft-close the active policy/fee-path session when the exact current ladder contains no otherwise-eligible contract with A_t_quote_cents>=100 whose D48 and D49 intent masks pass.
d49.soft_close_effect: permanent WAIT for new entries for the rest of the session; existing position may still HOLD/EXIT
d49.reason: $1.00 option premium times 100 plus the active fee path, combined with the causal current-ladder existence predicate

rejected_fill_accounting.trigger: the committed exact contract fails any t+1 identity/freshness, premium-floor, affordability, D48, or D49 recheck
rejected_fill_accounting.occupancy: the slot is reserved only through the t+1 resolution; the policy may next decide no earlier than t+2
rejected_fill_accounting.event: append the complete rejected-fill event required by intent_fill_recheck_law.json without rewriting the t intent

daily_stop.effect: no new entries for the session; existing position remains under lifecycle and protective exit rules

restart_recovery.required_result: bit-exact reconstruction of open quantity, cash reservations, realized_session_pnl_cents, D48 mask, D49 mask, soft-close state, and daily-stop state
restart_recovery.mismatch: block new entries and route to operator reconciliation; never choose the more permissive state

policy_comparison: each candidate and comparator owns a separate causal ledger; masks are recomputed from that policy's prior realized trades rather than shared after divergence
fail_closed_conditions: stale, late, ambiguous, or non-session-date session-start snapshot
non-dedicated paper account or unexplained external account state
